content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early forecast periods, especially after sharp spikes or volatility.
- Overestimates prices in the middle-to-late forecast horizon, particularly when recent history shows downward momentum.
- Tends to overshoot after sharp upward moves in history, then fails to correct downward quickly.
- Shows persistent lag in responding to recent price drops — forecasts remain too high longer than they should.
- Mean reversion is underemphasized — model doesn’t sufficiently adjust toward historical averages when prices deviate significantly.
- Overconfident in short-term momentum, especially when history shows no clear trend — forecasts drift too far from mean.
- Underestimates volatility in low-price regimes — model flattens out too early when prices are falling.
- High sensitivity to recent outliers — model reacts too strongly to single extreme values, causing overcorrection or undercorrection.
